channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Elon Musk invests about $1 billion in Skydance
item.description: David Ellison's father, billionaire and Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, has a history with Musk.

item.title: Moderna shares plunge after leak of cancer vaccine data despite positive results
item.description: Moderna's stock fell even though the full data, released later Thursday, appeared positive based on Wall Street expectations ahead of the release.

item.title: Trump defends Ramaswamy ad with Acton's estranged mom after bipartisan criticism
item.description: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine said GOP gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy should remove the ad featuring the mother of Democratic nominee Amy Acton.

item.title: Bill Ackman says 2027 will be an amazing year for stocks as wars, inflation ease
item.description: "We're going to have an amazing 2027," he said.

item.title: Trump asked Musk to lift Starlink slowdown, WSJ reports
item.description: Elon Musk, a critic of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, had ordered the slowdown of SpaceX's Starlink, The Wall Street Journal previously reported.

item.title: Personal agents like Meta's Muse could fuel AI’s growth — and challenge Amazon and Apple
item.description: Meta's Muse is taking off, but analysts say it's only the beginning

item.title: SpaceX and Tesla have high election stakes as Elon Musk pours $366 million into campaigns
item.description: Musk’s biggest political bet is on the Senate, where control could shape future investigations, federal spending and regulations affecting SpaceX and Tesla.

item.title: AI debt and French bonds face a stress test — why it may not be over
item.description: Bond markets are signaling unease over AI financing costs and sovereign debt in parts of Europe. More stress tests are coming.

item.title: Musk's clash with Ukraine accelerates demand for Starlink alternatives. Few exist
item.description: Governments or companies looking for an alternative to SpaceX's Starlink are faced with few options, as Amazon, Eutelsat and others are far behind.

item.title: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey
item.description: Eight out of 10 Americans now rate the economy as fair or poor, one of several findings in a CNBC poll that show why Republican candidates face uphill battles.

item.title: Cruise lines chase luxury travelers with suites for up to $25,000 a night
item.description: CNBC got a tour of the Regent Suite, a top-of-the-line offering on Regent's Seven Seas Splendor that goes for $15,000 a night.

item.title: American Express brings Airbnb bookings and rewards to Amex Travel platform
item.description: More than 1 million Airbnb listings are now available to book through Amex Travel, allowing customers to earn membership points on prepaid bookings.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Procter & Gamble, Lam Research, Blackstone, Southwest & more
item.description: These are some of the stocks posting the largest moves midday.

item.title: Lawsuit accuses Trump of illegally profiting off foreign crypto deals
item.description: "We're suing to stop the corruption and to force President Trump to return the profits to American taxpayers," attorney Matt Pelikan told CNBC.

item.title: Jobless claims near the lowest since the 1960s as low-fire trend continues
item.description: Initial filings for unemployment insurance slipped to a seasonally adjusted 194,000.

item.title: Under-the-radar stocks to play the next leg of the energy trade with oil prices jumping again
item.description: Iran is going to grow more desperate as oil money dries up, which makes the country even more dangerous.

item.title: Judge orders Trump to sit for deposition in BBC defamation lawsuit by Dec. 11: Reports
item.description: Trump's lawyers had requested that his deposition be conducted between Jan. 11 and Jan. 22.

item.title: CoreWeave’s market confidence erodes as bond yields spike and stock sinks
item.description: CoreWeave shares are down 35% in October, and the spreads in its credit default swaps are widening.

item.title: Pepsi renews contract with Taco Bell days after KFC switches to Coke in the U.S.
item.description: Taco Bell is sticking with longtime beverage supplier PepsiCo, even though sister chain KFC defected to Coca-Cola.

item.title: Third-party evaluators found vulnerabilities in OpenAI monitoring system during test pilot
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman pledged to grant independent evaluators "employee-like access" to the company to help address mounting safety concerns.

item.title: The perfect storm behind the Nasdaq's rout — plus, some of the bright spots in the market
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Now is your last chance to qualify for a Southwest Companion Pass with a credit card bonus
item.description: Southwest is rolling out major changes to how you can earn elite status and its Companion Pass. Apply for a Southwest credit card by Dec. 2, 2026, to help earn the pass.

item.title: Pharma's 'information arms dealer' is up nearly 80% from an April low. Josh Brown sees more gains
item.description: Josh Brown and Sean Russo break down this healthcare name on their Best Stocks in the Market list.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says neocloud demand is 'off the charts' but capital is scarce
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC Thursday that demand for neocloud firms is "off the charts," but scarce capital is holding back growth.

item.title: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas, a Trump critic, charged in marijuana racketeering case
item.description: The investigation into the Democrat predates the current Trump administration. But the timing of the indictment before the midterms has raised eyebrows.

item.title: Brent crude tops $113, highest level since May, after Trump hints at action on Iran
item.description: The Middle East conflict could flare up again as the U.S. reportedly plans to resume strikes against Iran.

item.title: FIFA launches tender of 2030 men's World Cup U.S. media rights, plans to choose winner by end of year
item.description: FIFA is formally auctioning its U.S. media rights and wants bids by Nov. 19.

item.title: Blackstone's Jon Gray says CoreWeave can 'find a way through' financing pressure
item.description: Blackstone COO Jon Gray says CoreWeave's underlying business is strong despite concerns over its mounting debt.

item.title: Why governments pulled websites offline over the decades-old PHP programming language
item.description: Servers that use the popular PHP programming language were exposed to a critical security bug. Millions of websites have their data at risk.

item.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he sees no sign of a 2029 memory glut: 'You can always use more'
item.description: Nvidia's Jensen Huang told CNBC that a surplus of memory supply is unlikely by 2029, as memory stocks have taken a beating in the past week.
